question: Which bank of India will mark its 90th anniversary in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established on **April 1, 1935**, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• The RBI is India's central bank, responsible for regulating the country's monetary policy, currency issuance, and financial stability.
 
• It initially started its operations in Kolkata but was permanently shifted to **Mumbai in 1937**.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India will complete **90 years of establishment in 2025.**
 
• The RBI's primary functions include controlling inflation, managing foreign exchange, and regulating banks and non-banking financial companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of RBI**

 
 
• The RBI was conceptualized based on the recommendations of the **Hilton Young Commission**.
 
• It was initially established as a private entity but was nationalized in **1949**.
 
 
 
• **RBI's Governance Structure**
 
 
• The RBI is governed by a central board of directors, which includes government-appointed officials and experts.
 
• The **Governor of RBI** serves as the chief executive officer and represents the bank.
 
 
 
• **Key Functions of RBI**
 
 
• Formulating and implementing monetary policy to maintain price stability and economic growth.
 
• Issuing and managing India's currency under the **Currency and Coinage Act**.
 
• Regulating and supervising banks and financial institutions to ensure financial stability.
 
• Maintaining foreign exchange reserves and managing exchange rates.
 
 
 
• **Important Milestones**
 
 
• The RBI played a critical role in the economic reforms of 1991 that liberalized India's economy.
 
• In recent years, it has introduced various digital initiatives like the **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** for promoting financial inclusion.
